question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

__Just when they reach__ the airport, the flight had departed from the runway.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence incorrectly uses the past perfect tense "had departed" with the phrase "Just when they reach," which is in the present tense. This creates a mismatch in the tenses.
 
• The phrase "Just before they reached" ensures the correct usage of past tense for both actions, maintaining consistency and clarity.
 
• Option 4 is the only choice that grammatically and logically fits the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Just when they have reached" uses the present perfect tense, which is incorrect in this context as the action is in the past.
 
• **Option 2:** "After they just reach" is grammatically incorrect and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 3:** "Just they reach" is incomplete and does not form a meaningful sentence.
